title: Context of the Organisation Register
purpose: Records the external and internal issues that matter to the organisation's purpose and direction and affect what its management system can achieve, and how those issues are monitored and reviewed.

questions.text: Which method does the organisation use to identify its issues?

Is climate change a relevant issue for the organisation? Record the decision and the reason. (The 2024 climate-change amendments to ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 ask organisations to make this determination.)
Who owns and maintains the register (role)?
How often, and where, are the issues reviewed (for example at management review)?

requiredSections: External issues (with how each is monitored)
Internal issues (with how each is monitored)
Effect on the management system and link to risks and opportunities
optionalSections: Completed SWOT or PESTLE worksheet as an appendix
expectedRecords: The completed SWOT or PESTLE worksheet
Management review minutes that review the issues
Risk and opportunity register entries that arise from the issues
draftingRules: Lay the issues out as a table: Issue | Internal or external | Category | Effect on the management system | Linked risk or opportunity | Owner | Last reviewed.
List only the issues supplied as confirmed information or answers; for anything else leave a placeholder row.
reviewerChecklist: Every listed issue is real for this organisation
Each issue says how it is monitored
The climate change decision is recorded with a reason
Issues are linked to the risk and opportunity register

sources.title: Etcher ISO gap analysis workbook V2.0 — evidence examples (column G)

brandingInstructions: Use the organisation's confirmed legal or trading name in the header, its logo reference (describe where the logo goes — do not invent one) and its confirmed brand colours for headings and table header rows. Put the document-control block in the footer or on a cover table. If a branding value is not confirmed, leave a placeholder.
